findings.detail: Root criterion c-change-explained is not met. The designated summarize-review artifact (acc-a550f23c314b63350f7a5c280dcccc01, port summary) does not explain an applied changeset: it restates defects and recommended fixes, then states that metrics/collector.py and metrics/reporter.py were not modified, the five defects remain in source, no concurrency/window/NTP tests were added, and production fixes have not been written. That does not satisfy evidence_requirement “summarize-review summary of inspect-changeset findings explains what changed and why” (inspect-changeset findings had recorded lock/snapshot/window/rate/test changes). Other artifacts cannot be used to mark this criterion met.
